assumptions: DECIDED (human, option a): no new ingest field or endpoint; quarantine rides on ResultEntry.tags, the only existing per-result carrier (there is no annotations field).
Tags: `quarantined` always, plus `quarantine:<issue>` when the ledger row names an issue; an issue-less row sends `quarantined` alone rather than an empty ticket tag.

Matching is katana's (file, test) identity: test_file === row.file and full_title equals or ends with ' > ' + row.test. Rows are matched AFTER dedupeByFullTitle, so a title skipped in one project/report and run in another is sent with its worst status and no quarantine tag (code-review finding, fixed).
Ledger rows of kind `removed` are excluded from the unmatched list (a deleted test never yields a result) and counted separately in the summary, so they are not dropped silently.

Loud-failure choice per neighbouring flags: `canary testtracker push` exits 1 with 'Nothing was pushed.' (same as an unreadable --junit); the Playwright reporter emits warn() (::warning:: under GitHub Actions) and pushes untagged (same as its other config errors, which never abort the run).

katana's parser is reused by runtime import() of agents/skills/claude-code/canary-katana/scripts/ledger.mjs, resolved from <pkg>/agents/skills (published; staged by build-engine.mjs since #757) then <repo>/agents/skills (checkout). Both paths were exercised locally. Existence is checked first because katana load() reads a missing file as an empty ledger.
The `collected` catalog carries no quarantine tags on either path (results only).
Reporter option `quarantineLedger` / env CANARY_INGEST_QUARANTINE_LEDGER resolve through resolveConfig like every other setting; the CLI flag passes the same option.
The new module is imported by ingest.ts and testtracker.ts, so it is not an entry point and was not added to entropy.entryPoints.
countTests moved from ingest.ts to ingest/describe.ts to keep ingest.ts under the 300-line perf cap without raising any allowance.
A roadmap row was added for #1321 (none existed) and AGENTS.md's linked-row counts moved 13 -> 14.
Autopilot persona dispatch was condensed: planning and execution ran inline in this lane; REVIEW was delegated to a harness-code-reviewer subagent.
